about: Neal S. Manne is an attorney at Susman Godfrey L.L.P. and helps clients address Business Litigation legal issues. He also assists clients regarding Civil Rights, Constitutional Law, General Litigation and Antitrust Litigation issues.
Super Lawyers is a designation of top-rated practicing attorneys selected through extensive evaluation. He was awarded this distinction for 2003 - 2026.
Neal Manne graduated in 1980 from The University of Texas School of Law.
Neal Manne was admitted to practice law in 1980. He represents clients in the Houston area.
